prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Hero illustration for a clinical research application 'Follow a patient. See what changes.' Premium handcrafted editorial paper sculpture, deep teal, sage, ivory, restrained ochre quotation highlights. Soft studio light, clean white background. Landscape 3:2, suitable for half-width website hero. No text, numbers, watermark or statistical charts. Each visit represented by its own ivory clinic letter with highlighted evidence, belonging to one patient. No implied cure or uniform improvement. Direction A: Human researcher reviewing a history. A thoughtful adult researcher in teal clothing at a desk studies an accordion-fold timeline of five distinct ivory visit records, unfolding across the desk. A single patient folder with raised paper person silhouette anchors the history. Some letters have ochre quotation strips; one has a visibly empty inset to suggest missing information. Warm human presence, clear temporal sequence, tactile paper craft, uncluttered.
